author: GameSpot
description:
Legendary comic creator Todd McFarlane talks about Spawn's appearance in Diablo Immortal, a crossover event launching on September 29, 2026. That's your chance to play a "badass guy with a red cape" in Diablo Immortal. Todd McFarlane and associate art director Emil Salim go over their collaborative process and how they picture Spawn fitting naturally into the world of Diablo.

The Rabbit Haul is available now.
